name: NGC 855 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 855, a dwarf elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc855-hubble
story: A small elliptical galaxy that is still forming stars at its center, activity perhaps set off by a minor merger. Hubble looked here for a dense cluster of stars at the galaxy's heart.

claims.text: NGC 855 is a dwarf elliptical galaxy
It has star formation in its center, possibly triggered by a minor merger
Hubble imaged it to look for a nuclear star cluster
